Why buy a whole new kitchen when we can give your old one a new lease of life?

Many people look at their kitchen and think it needs replacing, when all it needs is a professional kitchen specialist to bring it back to its former glory. RDS are Southampton, Winchester and the New Forest's specialists in traditional hand-painted kitchens. Get that new-kitchen feeling at a fraction of the cost of replacing your kitchen.

  1. Preparation

    The team removes and cleans all handles, sanitises and de-greases doors and drawers, and masks worktops with lining paper and tape, then lays a protective spill-proof, impact-resistant board.

  2. Sanding

    Festool dust-free sanding equipment is used on every part of the kitchen, ready for primer and top coats. Extra time here stops chipping and peeling.

  3. Priming

    A high-adhesion primer, Benjamin Moore Stix or Caparol Haft, which can be tinted to match your chosen top coat for better coverage and depth of colour.

  4. Top coats

    At least two top coats of your chosen colour. Benjamin Moore Advance comes in matt, satin and gloss finishes.

We also hand-paint furniture.

A professional hand-painting service for all of your wooden furniture. RDS can bring new colour and life to your tired chairs, beds, wardrobes and pretty much anything else. All hand-painted kitchens and furniture are prepared with Festool dust-free sanding and dust extraction.

Decorating services, indoors and out.

RDS have a wealth of experience in bringing out the best in a room, or in a whole property. Arrange a free, no-obligation quote.

Interiors

There's nothing like a professionally decorated room, but getting a professional finish can be difficult and time-consuming for the DIYer. Specialist or practical wallpapering, and advice on a colour scheme to suit you.

Exterior painting and restoration

Expertly sanding and repainting timber windows, or applying high-performance, weatherproof coatings to external walls, for a flawless, long-lasting finish.

Woodwork restoration

Banisters looking tired, doors marked, skirting boards worn? Restored with Benjamin Moore paints, chosen for quality, durability and a flawless finish.

Dust-free sanding

RDS use Festool dust-free sanding and dust extraction. The best finishes start with the best preparation, and the extraction keeps the working environment as safe as possible.

Commercial decorating

RDS have decorated businesses such as Sainsbury's, Little Brook Retirement Home, Whitewoods Letting Agencies, Leaders Letting Agencies and Pearsons Estate Agencies since 2003, with minimum possible disruption to your own business or organisation.

English Heritage and listed buildings

RDS specialise in servicing and restoring English Heritage and listed buildings to their former glory in Southampton and throughout Hampshire, with an understanding of the materials and the strict guidelines of the restoration process.
